faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Allahabad University JRA recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email is 15 September 2026. Ensure your application reaches before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Junior Research Assistant post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.Sc. degree in Life Science, Environmental Science, or a related discipline with a first-class academic record.

faq.question: Q3. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Junior Research Assistant position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Junior Research Assistant post is 28 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the JRA post?
faq.answer: The salary offered is Rs. 25,000/- per month for the first two years and Rs. 28,000/- per month for the third year, on a consolidated basis.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply for the Allahabad University JRA recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email. You need to send your complete application along with required documents to the specified email address.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Junior Research Assistant position will be based on an interview.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a contractual job?
faq.answer: Yes, the Junior Research Assistant (JRA) position is on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q9. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment is CST/ENV/D-1010.

faq.question: Q10. Where is Allahabad University located?
faq.answer: Allahabad University is located in Prayagraj, Uttar Pradesh.
